items.headline: Serbian President Concedes Defeat to Student Movement in Historic Election
items.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić conceded defeat on Sunday after preliminary election results showed a student-led movement winning a parliamentary majority. The vote marks a major political shift in the Balkan nation following years of widespread anti-government protests against his twelve-year rule.

items.headline: Elvis Presley Estate Sues AI Firm Anthropic Over Song Copyrights
items.summary: The owners of Elvis Presley's music catalog filed a federal lawsuit against AI startup Anthropic, alleging the company trained its Claude model on 274 of the singer's copyrighted songs without permission. Seeking over $41 million in damages, the high-profile case marks one of the first major legal challenges brought directly by an iconic artist's estate against an AI developer.

items.headline: Kylian Mbappé Scores Late Winner as Real Madrid Beats Barcelona in El Clásico
items.summary: Real Madrid defeated arch-rivals Barcelona 2–1 at Camp Nou on Sunday in the first El Clásico match of the season. Kylian Mbappé scored twice, including an 87th-minute winning goal, handing Barcelona their first domestic league defeat of the campaign.

items.headline: DC Horror Thriller 'Clayface' Tops Box Office with $24 Million Debut
items.summary: DC Studios' new R-rated horror movie 'Clayface' claimed the top spot at the weekend box office with an estimated $24 million debut in North America. Meanwhile, A24's Elizabeth Holmes documentary 'You Can See Everything' expanded to thousands of theaters and finished second with $19.5 million.
